newsitem.title: USA: Paxson ceases talks for the TV station sales.
newsitem.headline: Paxson ceases talks for the TV station sales.

text.p: Paxson Communications Corp said on Monday it ceased current negotiations to sell WPBF TV-25, which it owns, and WTVX TV-34, the affiliate it operates pursuant to a time brokerage agreement with Whitehead Media Inc.
Both stations serve the West Palm Beach, Fla., market.
The company said Jeffrey Amling, managing director of Alex Brown & Sons Inc, will continue to advise Paxson Communications on certain strategic alternatives, including the sale of these stations.
